report.title: Constancia Mine, Cuzco, Peru Form 43-101F1 Technical Report
report.effective_date_quote: Constancia, with an effective date of January 1st, 2021

flowsheet.quote: Each train consists of a single FLSmidth semi-autogenous grinding (SAG) mill, a ball mill and a potential addition of a pebble crusher (SABC)

facts.quote: The plant has now demonstrated its capacity to process approximately 90 ktpd of ore (31 Mtpa at 94% plant availability)

context.note: demonstrated; original design 76,000 t/d at 91.3% availability

facts.quote: the annual throughput capacity was increased from 25.3 milltion to 31.4 million tonnes per year
the primary grind size was increased from 106 µm to 155 µm (nominal)
